newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-OrNda cut to hold from buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-OrNda cut to hold from buy.

text.p: --Chicago Corp said Tuesday it had cut its rating on OrNda HealthCorp Inc to hold from buy to reflect the rise in the price of shares of Tenet HealthCare Corp and OrNda.
--It said the rise followed an announcement in late October that Tenet, a hospital chain, plans to acquire OrNda, a competing hospital chain.
--"The OrNda-Tenet deal appears to be progressing well, although the Federal Trade Commission has made a second request for information on three common markets," Chicago Corp said in a report.
--OrNda was unchanged at 30-3/8 and Tenet was off 1/4 at 23.
